Add account freezing

summary.intent: Add account freezing: a frozen account accepts no new entries until it is unfrozen (spec `ledger-spec/account-freeze`).
summary.issue_fit: Partial — freezing, unfreezing, refused postings and refused transfers out of a frozen account are implemented; criterion 2's refusal of transfers into a frozen account is not.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff reviewed (2 files), with the fix delta `864eea8..03ce7cd` read in full. Reviewer-executed `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` at the head: 17 tests, pass.

findings.title: Refuse transfers that touch a frozen account
findings.trigger: A transfer names a frozen account as its target.
findings.impact: `Ledger.transfer` refuses a frozen source but appends the credit to a frozen target, so that account is credited despite the freeze that spec criterion 2 forbids.
findings.change: In `Ledger.transfer` (`ledger/accounts.py:85`), also raise `LedgerError` before appending either entry when the target account is frozen.

findings.title: Name the frozen-account error in the post docstring
findings.trigger: A caller reads `Ledger.post`'s docstring to learn which errors to handle.
findings.impact: The docstring still lists only zero amounts, overdrafts, and unknown accounts, although `post` now raises `LedgerError` for a frozen account.
findings.change: Add the frozen-account case to the `Ledger.post` docstring at `ledger/accounts.py:61`.
findings.source: `AGENTS.md`: every public function's docstring names the errors it raises.

prior_items.note: ledger/accounts.py:85-86 at 03ce7cd refuses a frozen source only; a transfer into a frozen account still reaches the credit append at ledger/accounts.py:90
ledger/accounts.py:61 at 03ce7cd still lists no frozen-account error in the post docstring

requirements.evidence: ledger/accounts.py:52-58 sets and clears `frozen` through `self.get`, which raises for an unknown account
ledger/accounts.py:85-86 refuses a frozen source; ledger/accounts.py:90 still credits a frozen target
ledger/accounts.py:65-66 raises before the append at ledger/accounts.py:70; tests/test_freeze.py:15-21
